_note: One-line purposes for components whose source has no header comment. Written from reading each file's props, signals and children, not from the file's own prose; mark = verify when documenting.
src/Gui/athlete/PpAthleteCard.qml: Tile for one athlete in the picker grid: avatar initials on a colour derived from the athlete, name and a 'last seen' line (today / yesterday / N days ago / no sessions yet); selected and hover states. Emits clicked.
src/Gui/athlete/PpAthleteRow.qml: Compact list-row form of the athlete tile for the picker's list layout (same avatar/last-seen data as PpAthleteCard, 'Nd ago' format); adds a pencil-on-hover edit affordance (editRequested) beside the selectable row.
src/Gui/athlete/ScreenAthleteForm.qml: Full-screen create/edit form for an athlete (name, DOB, sex, handedness, height/weight with unit toggles, primary club). Buffers scalar fields until Save; hosts AthleteClubsSection in edit mode. Emits saved / savedAndStarted / cancelled.
src/Gui/athlete/ScreenAthletePicker.qml: Full-screen athlete chooser: search, a 'Recent' section and 'All athletes' as PpAthleteCard grid or PpAthleteRow list; new athlete, import roster, edit and delete actions. Emits athleteSelected / newAthleteRequested / editAthleteRequested.
src/Gui/cameras/VideoPage.qml: Camera video page: camera selector (one toggle chip per discovered camera), start/stop recording, overrun warning, and a PpCameraFrame per selected camera. Hosted by PlayPage (the 'Pose' tab).
src/Gui/components/PpButton.qml: The app's standard button: label and/or glyph/icon, with primary, destructive and attention variants. Built on PpPressable. Emits clicked.
src/Gui/components/PpChipGroup.qml: Single-select row of text chips (options array, selected value, optional disabled options). Emits selectionChanged, and blockedClicked when a disabled chip is pressed.
src/Gui/components/PpDivider.qml: Hairline rule, horizontal or vertical, in the theme's border colour.
src/Gui/components/PpTextField.qml: Themed single-line text input (a styled TextField) with a hasError state.
src/Gui/components/PpTopoBackground.qml: Animated topographic contour-line background (noise-driven contours in three tone colours), used behind home, session-mode and placeholder screens.
src/Gui/components/PpUnitToggle.qml: Compact segmented toggle between units (e.g. cm/ft-in, kg/lb). Emits selectionChanged.
src/Gui/home/ScreenHome.qml: The home screen. First run: welcome/onboarding (add an athlete, connect a camera, pair IMUs, read the docs). Thereafter, as docs/design/ux_refactor_away_from_4_modes.md §2.3 lays it out: a Start card (Start session, club picker, last session, and what this rig can measure), the Coaching | Your swing tabs over the work-ons, and the session list.
src/Gui/imu/CapturePage.qml: IMU capture page: scan/connect, Viz and Log tabs, Arm and Body 3-D views (persistent ImuVizView/ArmVizView/BodyVizView bound to the first active IMU), Zero and Save Log. Hosted by PlayPage (dev hatch).
src/Gui/media/AudioPage.qml: Audio page (dev hatch): live speech-to-text transcript pane (CPU, GPU or Azure cloud) and a text-to-speech pane, in a vertical SplitView; model-download progress.
src/Gui/media/CoachPage.qml: AI Coach chat page: local LLM or cloud (Gemini) backend toggle, download/loading overlay, latency badge, chat transcript, voice-in and voice-out toggles. Hosted by PlayPage (dev hatch).
src/Gui/media/FilmPage.qml: Film page: paste a YouTube URL, download via yt-dlp, a cache list, and playback with 10 s skip, pause/stop and an Annotate mode. NOTE: nothing instantiates this file (PlayPage no longer lists it).
src/Gui/monitor/RmDeviceCard.qml: Resource-monitor card for one device: header strip with status, then rows of readings (identifier, resolution, crop size, frame rate, events/bytes written, ring size, address, connection/protocol e.g. GSPro Open Connect); button to jump to its settings (openSettingsRequested).
src/Gui/monitor/RmSourceRow.qml: Resource-monitor table row for one data source, with alternate-row shading.
src/Gui/monitor/RmTimelineChart.qml: Resource-monitor bar-timeline: a rolling history of values (and buffer state) drawn as barCount bars scaled to maxVal.
src/Gui/monitor/RmWarningNotice.qml: Inline warning notice: warn-tinted rounded strip with a 'Warning' label and message. Used on the home screen to surface resource problems.
src/Gui/monitor/ScreenResourceMonitor.qm: The Resource Monitor screen (2.4k lines): Devices (scan), Event buffer, Timeline, Sources and registered-sources tables, PPCP phone/camera stats, and a tabbed bottom area (Message Log, Stats History, Analysis Runs, PinPointCapture).
src/Gui/settings/AppearancePanel.qml: Settings > Appearance: aesthetic and colour-mode gallery (each card previews its own theme from Theme.themeInfo), per-theme metric-colour editors with reset, and type scale / text size.
src/Gui/settings/CamerasPanel.qml: Settings > Cameras (3.1k lines, largest file in the GUI): per-camera rows (alias, enable, view assignment face-on / down-the-line / impact, mirror, frame rate), live preview, tuning (exposure/gain), ROI and ball-detection set-up, impact-camera defaults.
src/Gui/settings/DisplaysPanel.qml: Settings > Displays: connected screens (friendly vendor names from EDID codes) and which one hosts the main Pinpoint window vs the post-shot display, and which monitor to launch on.
src/Gui/settings/GeneralPanel.qml: Settings > General: language (7 locales), measurement units, session behaviour (auto-detect swing start and sensitivity, AI coaching on session end), cloud fallback keys; lazily triggers the motion-capture hardware probe when first shown.
src/Gui/settings/ImusPanel.qml: Settings > IMUs (1.8k lines): device rows with alias/enable/exclude, per-device test panel with live 3-D view and sensor ranges/battery/transport, placement, and who holds a device (HackMotion vs Witmotion).
src/Gui/settings/MicrophonesPanel.qml: Settings > Microphone: input devices (rescan, system default), use-for-shot-detection toggle, distance to hitting strip, and impact-sound calibration with the 'ting' test player.
src/Gui/settings/ScreenSettings.qml: The Settings screen: left navigation (General, Appearance, Displays; Hardware: Cameras, IMUs, Phones, Microphone, Launch Monitor; Data: Storage, Archiving, Diagnostic Model), search (SettingsIndex) with scroll-to-highlight, panel stack, and a pinned System Info action.
src/Gui/settings/SettingsIndex.qml: Singleton: full-text search index of every settings panel's entries (title, description, keywords, panelIndex and item id) that ScreenSettings searches and scrolls to.
src/Gui/settings/StoragePanel.qml: Settings > Storage: athlete-library location, folder-naming order (date/athlete/session type), video codec (H.264/H.265), resolution and quality presets, and disk/size estimates (cheap volume info plus a worker-measured session size).
src/Gui/shell/MacAboutMenu.qml: macOS-only native menu-bar shim (Qt.labs.platform MenuBar) loaded by Main.qml through a Loader; provides the About and Quit entries via native roles. Must never be instantiated on Linux/Windows, where the header version pill opens About.
src/Gui/shell/Main.qml: The application window (ApplicationWindow, created hidden then positioned on the chosen display): rail + header + screen stack (Home, Swing, Wrist, Ground forces, Coach, Developer, athletes, System, Settings), session-in-progress quit confirmation, about dialog, update banner, notification host, cast window and debounced geometry persistence.
src/Gui/shell/PlayPage.qml: Developer-hatch container (Main.qml: 'screenPlay — dev-hatch only') with a TabBar over CapturePage (IMU), AudioPage, CoachPage (AI) and VideoPage (Pose).
src/Gui/shell/PpHeader.qml: Top header bar: screen name after a separator, back/forward, version pill (About on Linux/Windows), analysing badge, and a centred device-detect cluster shown only on session screens; fullscreen toggle.
src/Gui/shell/PpRail.qml: Left navigation rail (Home, Swing, Wrist, GRF, Coach, Settings) of PpRailButtons plus the athlete avatar; locks to System and Settings only while a session screen is active.
src/Gui/shell/PpRailButton.qml: One rail button: icon and label, active/muted/attention states.
src/Gui/viz/ArmVizView.qml: 3-D rigid Y-bot arm (upper arm, forearm, hand as bone-local GLBs) driven by IMU quaternions, with orbit camera (drag/scroll) and orientation tabs.
src/Gui/viz/BodyVizView.qml: 3-D full Y-bot body assembled from bone-local GLBs and driven by a pose source (optionally mirrored), with joint markers, lead-arm highlight, loading progress and orbit camera.
src/Gui/viz/ImuVizView.qml: 3-D View3D of a single IMU as a labelled cube (Top/Bottom/Front/Back/Left/Right faces) driven by the fused quaternion of its controller, with the Z-up IMU world to Y-up scene basis change applied on a parent node.
